remainingUncertainty: Brazil has no state urban-lot cadastre found open; urban lots are municipal (IPTU). The only region-wide open polygon layer found is SICAR/CAR (rural properties, self-declared environmental registrations, not the legal cadastre). Time-boxed probes of state IDE/capital hosts (SIEG GO, GEOBASES ES, Geoweb Vitoria hub search, Maceio, Manaus, CE SEFAZ/IPECE, BA SEI) mostly failed DNS/connection, returned 403, or showed no lot layer; not proof of absence.
